summary:
艾司摩爾EPS略低於預期，惟營收規模強勁、長期需求不變。
• EPS 7.34美元，略低於預期7.55美元，驚喜幅度-2.72%。
• 單季營收97.2億美元，反映設備出貨旺季強勁。
• EUV微影獨家供應地位維持，技術領先優勢明確。
• AI與先進製程長期需求結構支撐訂單能見度。
• 服務與升級收入持續貢獻穩定現金流。
ai_view:
訊號中性偏正向：EPS小幅低於預期，但僅2.72%且營收規模強勁，無損長期成長邏輯。ASML的單季波動屬常態，重點在淨訂單與長期需求結構。短中期股價受AI先進製程資本支出循環驅動。追蹤指標：淨訂單趨勢、High-NA EUV採用進度、出口管制政策變化、各區域與終端應用需求。技術獨佔地位使其在半導體設備中具不可取代性，估值溢價有支撐但須訂單持續驗證。

需留意：訂單批次性導致季度業績波動。；出口管制限制中國等市場銷售動能。；高估值對任何訂單放緩訊號敏感。

summary_en:
ASML slightly misses EPS, but revenue stays strong with intact long-term demand.
• EPS of $7.34 slightly missed the $7.55 estimate, a 2.72% shortfall.
• Quarterly revenue of $9.72B reflects strong equipment-shipment seasonality.
• Exclusive EUV supply position maintains a clear technology lead.
• AI and advanced-node long-term demand supports order visibility.
• Service and upgrade revenue continues to provide stable cash flow.

ai_view_en:
Signal neutral-to-positive: a small EPS miss of only 2.72% with strong revenue, leaving the long-term growth thesis intact. ASML's quarterly volatility is normal; focus on net bookings and long-term demand structure. Near to mid-term, the stock is driven by the AI advanced-node capex cycle. Track: net bookings trend, High-NA EUV adoption, export-control policy changes, and regional and end-market demand. Its technology monopoly makes it irreplaceable in semi equipment, supporting a valuation premium that still needs order validation.

Watch：Lumpy orders cause quarterly earnings volatility.; Export controls limit sales momentum in markets such as China.; High valuation is sensitive to any sign of order slowdown.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS驚喜-2.72%，營收97.2億美元，單季略遜但動能仍在。
